{"file":"SlimJxmmiCapital-setup.exe","notes":"New: prices from TopstepX. Besides Databento, the app can read NQ prices with the same ProjectX API login it trades with, so no second subscription is needed. Databento stays the recommended feed (the cleanest, and the one backtesting uses). Settings, API keys, PRICES FROM: Databento or TopstepX.
The DEMO section can take its prices from either one too (PRICES, in its settings row), so you can run one on each.
The first start now asks only for your email and license key. Every key is added afterwards, in Settings, API keys.
If you are updating from before 0.4.73: upload the strategy file built for this version (Settings, Firms and strategy).","published":"2026-11-21T14:38:48+00:00","sha256":"8c3f5e5ef7efdfa21944a6fcb3084ee17d217e844da8e3102a2114bc0ba7e945","size":24274030,"version":"0.4.81"}
